scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on her account and requesting a refund if unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Mei Li and I'm 29. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Mei, I'm sorry to hear about the confusion regarding that charge. I would be happy to help you investigate this. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the email address associated with your profile for verification?
Sure, my account number is 88492011, and my email is mei.li@email.com.

Thank you, Mei. I have successfully verified your identity. I'm looking at the transaction now—it is listed as 'Digital Services Corp' for $76.00 on October 12th. Does that name sound familiar, or would you like me to pull up the merchant contact details for you?
No, that name doesn't ring a bell at all. I haven't signed up for any digital services recently.

I understand. Since you do not recognize the merchant, I have initiated a formal dispute per our 'Unauthorized Transaction Policy,' which requires us to block the card to prevent further unauthorized activity. I have processed a provisional credit of $76.00 to your account, which will be available within 1-3 business days while our fraud team completes their investigation.
Oh, that's a relief. Will I be getting a new card sent out then?

Yes, Mei. A replacement card with a new number has been ordered and will arrive at your registered mailing address within 5-7 business days. You can track this in the 'Cards' section of your app. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer, confirmed the unrecognized transaction, initiated a formal dispute, issued a provisional credit, and ordered a replacement card.

judge_scores.justification: The agent efficiently verified the customer's identity, provided warm and professional support, and correctly grounded their actions in the 'Unauthorized Transaction Policy' by issuing a provisional credit, blocking the card, and ordering a replacement. Every turn was purposeful, resulting in a swift and comprehensive resolution without unnecessary escalation.
